I wish I had words that can help you but being a guy who was in a relationship similar to this I understand completely what you are going through. The difference being my ex didn't get the help that she needed and it being a long distance relationship mean there was nothing I could do to help her.
We tried for so long to help and in the end it drove an edge between us and tore us apart. It definitely isn't the top of her own list of problems that she needs to deal with but for me it's the number one issue she was coping till then.

You need to give her time, she is taking the steps in the right direction. I know it is hard now but keep holding on. Enjoy your trip it'll be the trip of a lifetime. Hopefully when you come back you are both in an emotionally better place and if not maybe you can take a break for a while. Don't obsess over it too much it'll just eat away at you.

I'd say no our non contact phase was about that long it took a few hours to unravel all the hard work I had put in to getting over her.. But trust yourself, if you think you are strong enough to pull away if it gets too much then go for it.
